rules.games.intro: Predict the final score of every game. The closer you are, the more points you earn.
rules.r.exactSub: Additional {n} bonus on top of exact margin
rules.r.uniqueSub: Additional {n} bonus on top of right winner + exact score, for being the only player who predicted the exact score
rules.r.diffSub: Right winner, and the margin of victory was off by {err}
rules.r.missSub: You missed the winning team: no points and no extra bonus
rules.note.auto: If you don't predict a game before it starts, the system fills in a random result for you. An auto-filled pick earns at most {pct}% of the points (rounded down) and never the unique bonus. It is marked with 🎲 in the lists.
rules.risk.intro: When {pct}% or fewer of the players predicted the right winner of a game, everyone who got it right earns {pts} bonus points on top of the regular scoring.
rules.risk.rightSub: {pct}% or fewer of the players picked this winner, and you got it right: bonus
rules.risk.popSub: More than {pct}% picked the winner: no risk bonus
rules.risk.note: The risk bonus is added to the regular score, it doesn't replace it. For example: right winner ({winner}) + risk bonus ({pts}) = {total} points.
rules.bonus.intro: Bonus questions are special questions for the whole competition. Each question has its own number of points.
rules.bonus.rightSub: The points of each question are set separately by the admin
rules.bonus.wrongSub: No points for a wrong answer
rules.bonus.lock: ⚠️ Bonus questions lock at the deadline set for each question.
rules.joker.intro: A player can use a joker on selected games to multiply the points (×{n}).
rules.joker.title: Joker multiplies the score earned for a game by {n}
rules.joker.note: You can use a joker on any game, and move it to another game, until the game starts. The joker multiplies everything you earn on that game, including the unique and risk bonuses.
rules.h2h.intro: Head to Head has a group league, a knockout and pairs for fun. Only game points count here, bonus points don't.
rules.h2h.league.title: 🏟️ Group league
rules.h2h.league.b2: Points in this stage come only from the regular games, with no bonus points.
rules.h2h.league.advN: The top {n} of every group advance to the knockout.
rules.h2h.league.adv: The top players of every group advance to the knockout.
rules.h2h.ko.title: 🏆 Knockout
rules.h2h.ko.b1: Players are seeded: group winners first, then runners-up. The best seed plays the weakest seed.
rules.h2h.ko.b2: In each stage, the player who earns more game points during that stage wins and advances. Every stage starts from zero.
rules.h2h.fun.title: 🎉 Pairs for fun
rules.h2h.fun.body: Friends can compete against each other just for fun.
rules.tb.h2h.title: Tie-breaker: knockout stage
rules.tb.board.title: Tie-breaker: leaderboard
rules.lock: A prediction locks the moment a game starts. Predictions can't be changed after the lock, and everyone's picks become visible then.
lb.streakLegend: 🔥 3 or more correct winners in a row · ❄️ 3 or more misses in a row
results.noFinished: No finished games in this period.
rb.waiting: Closed, waiting for the correct answer
rb.soon: Answers will be visible in a moment.
pred.noGamesWeek: No games in the next 7 days.
pred.missingTip: {n} games in the next 7 days without a prediction
pl.note: Only finished and live games are shown.
pl.noGames: No finished or live games with a prediction yet.
bq.poolPts: Pool points (split equally between East and West)
bq.rankHint: Put the teams of each conference in their real final order. Saving it closes the question and scores everyone.
rk.hint: Move the teams (▲▼ or drag) to build your ranking for each conference. It saves automatically once you move a team.
rules.rank.title: 🏆 Ranking questions (East and West)
rules.rank.body: Rank all 15 teams of the East and all 15 teams of the West by their final regular-season standing. The question's points are split equally between the two conferences. In each conference you lose points for every place a team finishes away from where you put it ({pen} per place). You can't go below 0 in a conference.
rules.rank.example: 📌 Example: a ranking question worth {pool} points = {half} for each conference. You put a team 3rd and it finishes 5th: 2 places off = −{loss}. Two teams swapped by one place = 2 places = −{loss}.
bq.rankInfo: Up to {n} pts (East + West), −{p} per place missed
adm.noPlay: You're an admin. Admin accounts don't take part in the competition, so they can't submit predictions or bonus answers and don't appear in the tables. Players see this page with the input fields.

home.allSet: All set: no missing predictions in the next 3 days
home.youStar: You're the star of the night!

bq.order.how: Use ▲▼ to move a question inside its section; players see your order instead of the automatic one.
bq.order.confirmReset: Go back to the automatic order (by question type)? Your manual order will be cleared.

pls.promptHe: Name of the list in Hebrew:

ag.managerNote: You are the games manager: add or import games, and change, cancel or delete games that have NOT started. Scores, results and finished or live games are managed by the admin.
ag.managerFormNote: You can set a game to scheduled or cancelled. Scores and results are set by the admin.
ag.managerLocked: This game has started: only the admin can change it.
au.gm.badge: Games manager: can add games and change / cancel / delete games that have not started.

au.gm.doneOn: Done. He must sign out and in again to see the Games tab.
au.gm.doneOff: Removed. It takes effect when he signs in again (up to an hour at most).
auth.nameRules: Your real first and last name (at least 2 letters each, any language). It shows in the tables, and only the admin can change it later.
auth.errName: Enter your first and last name (letters only, at least 2 letters each).
pay.waiting: Your registration is complete. Waiting for admin approval.
pay.waitingLong: Your registration is complete, but you can't submit predictions or bonus answers yet. The admin will unlock this page after confirming your payment. Meanwhile you can browse the other pages.
rules.takanonIntro: The full regulations of the game (PDF, in Hebrew):
sc.diffExact: Exact margin bonus (right winner and the exact difference between the teams)
sc.uniqueDiff: Unique exact margin bonus (the only player with the exact margin, without the exact score)
rules.r.margin0uSub: Additional {n} bonus on top of right winner and exact margin, for being the only player with the exact difference between the teams (without the exact score)
rules.ex.title: Worked example: the game ended 110–102 (a margin of 8)
rules.ex.winnerOnly: Right winner, off by more than {n}
bm.hint: Checks every PAID player (players who haven't paid can't answer yet). A question counts as answered when the player has saved an answer.
bm.summary: {n} of {total} players have missing answers ({q} questions checked).
bm.none: Everyone has answered all the questions 🎉
bm.copyFail: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
gm.hint: Checks every PAID player (players who haven't paid can't predict yet) for games that start soon and have no saved prediction. Auto-fill happens only at tip-off, so every game that hasn't started needs a real pick.
gm.summary: {n} of {total} players are missing predictions ({g} games in the next {d} days).
gm.none: Everyone has predicted all the games of the next {d} days 🎉
gm.noGames: No games to predict in the next {d} days.
lb.jokersNote: Jokers each player has left (out of {n} per season). A joker counts as spent when its game starts; jokers on upcoming games are not shown.
ev.liveNote: Live points: based on the current score, they can change until the game ends.
ev.tiedNote: The game is tied right now, so nothing is scored yet.
ev.waitingNote: No live score yet: the points appear as soon as the first score update arrives.
pred.noOpenGames: No games to predict right now. Games that have started, their live scores and everyone's picks are in the Results page.
lb.monthNote: Game points only, no bonus questions. Every month starts from zero. The month is the date of the game in Israel. Players equal on points, exact hits and unique hits share the title.
lb.monthSoon: Champion of the month starts on {month} 1. Every month will have its own table, from zero: game points only, no bonus questions.
mid.empty: The groups of the mid-season tournament have not been set yet.
mid.tiedDecision: A tie: waiting for the admin's decision.
mid.note: Game points only, no bonus questions, inside the dates of each stage. The top 2 of every group advance. Quarter finals: A1-B2, B1-A2, C1-D2, D1-C2; semi finals: the winner of quarter final 1 against the winner of quarter final 3, and the winner of quarter final 2 against the winner of quarter final 4. In a tie: more correct winners, then more exact hits, then more unique hits, then the higher overall score in the main table. The joker's double points do not count here, only in the main table.
am.hint: Put the players into the groups (the draw is done elsewhere); each drop-down shows only players who are not in a group yet. Recommended with 23 players: 6 + 6 + 6 + 5. The table, the quarter finals, the semi finals and the final are calculated by themselves from the game points inside the dates of each stage; the admin is needed only for a real tie.
am.summary: {total} players in groups ({sizes}); {free} players are not in a group.
am.noDecisions: No tie is waiting for a decision.
am.groupDecision: Group {g}: a tie for the places that advance. Choose the first and the second place.
am.pairDecision: {pair}: the players are equal on everything. Choose the winner.
rules.mid.intro: A separate side competition that runs next to the main table: the players are split into four groups, and after the group stage a knockout leads to a final. The winner of the final is the mid-season tournament champion. Only game points count here; the main table is not affected.
rules.mid.scheduleTitle: Schedule (Israel dates, by the date of the game)
rules.mid.groups.b1: The players are split into four groups (A, B, C and D). The draw and the placement are done by the admin.
rules.mid.groups.b2: Inside each group the ranking is by the game points collected during the dates of the group stage, without bonus points.
rules.mid.groups.b3: The top 2 of every group advance to the quarter finals.
rules.mid.tb.title: A tie
rules.mid.tb.body: Correct winners, then more exact scores, then more unique hits, then the higher overall score in the main table.
rules.mid.where: The groups, the pairs and the live results are in the Leaderboard page, in the “Mid-season tournament” tab.
pred.err.notPaid: Your registration is still waiting for the admin's approval (payment), so predictions can't be saved yet.
pred.err.blocked: Your account is blocked. Contact the admin.
pred.err.admin: An admin account does not take part in the predictions.
pred.err.noProfile: Your profile was not found. Sign out and sign in again.
pred.err.denied: You are not allowed to save here. Sign out and in again, or contact the admin.
pred.err.login: You were signed out. Sign in again.
pred.err.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
rules.mid.joker: The double points of the joker do not count in the mid-season tournament, in any stage. They count only in the main table.
rules.month.intro: Every month has its own table, starting from zero. The leader at the end of the month is the champion of the month.
rules.month.b1: The months: from {from} to {to}. A month opens on the 1st; until then its tab is grey.
rules.month.b2: Only game points count, no bonus questions. The joker doubles the points like in the main table.
rules.month.b3: The month is decided by the date of the game in Israel.
rules.month.b4: In a tie on points: more exact scores, then more unique hits. If that is equal too, the title is shared.
rules.month.where: You can see it in the Leaderboard page, in the second row, in the “Champion of the month” tab.
